header.title: Settings
header.subtitle: Configure your personal language preferences, client audio setup, and layout settings.

error.hint: Please make sure the backend services are running.

speakLanguage.label: Default Speak Language
speakLanguage.hint: The default language you will speak during translated sessions.

listenLanguage.label: Default Listen Language
listenLanguage.hint: The language you wish to hear or see translated transcripts in.

voiceClone.label: Enable Voice Cloning
voiceClone.hint: Synthesize translations using your approved voice profiles.

noiseSuppression.label: Microphone Noise Suppression
noiseSuppression.hint: Filter background static noise during translation calls.

roomType.label: Default Room Connection Type
roomType.hint: Preferred streaming protocol for your rooms.

autoRecord.label: Auto Record Translation Rooms
autoRecord.hint: Automatically record and save audio stream inputs when starting a meeting.

autoSummary.label: Auto Generate AI Summaries
autoSummary.hint: Trigger AI summaries and transcripts immediately when meetings conclude.

maxParticipants.label: Default Max Participants
maxParticipants.hint: Set the default capacity limit for rooms created by you.

theme.label: Interface Theme
theme.hint: Select your personal default display style.
